question: In which of the following languages did Jyotiba Phule write 'Gulamgiri' in 1873?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Marathi__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **Gulamgiri **by Mahatma Jyotiba Phule is regarded as one of the earliest tracts opposing the caste system.
 
• It was written in 1873 in Marathi language
 
• In 1885, it was published.
 
• It uses a** 16-part essay and four lyrical pieces **to criticise the caste system.
 
• It is written as a conversation between a character named Dhondiba and Jotiba. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Jyotiba Phule (11 April 1827 – 28 November 1890)** was a Maharashtra-born Indian social reformer, writer, and anti-caste crusader.
 
• He and his wife, Savitribai Phule, were forerunners in India when it came to women's education.
 
• **In 1848**, Phule established his first girls-only school in Pune in Tatyasaheb Bhide's house, also known as Bhidewada.
 
• In order to secure equal rights for members of lower castes, he founded the **Satyashodhak Samaj (Society of Truth Seekers)** along with his adherents.
